## AI-assisted scope drafting

- When AI is enabled and no scope file is provided, prepare an editable,
  phase-organized scope draft using extracted drawing notes, BOM rows and the
  app's review index.
- Mark each generated task for verification and include references to source
  drawing pages or BOM items. AI-transcribed rows are labeled as provisional.
- Keep the prior extractive evidence list when AI is disabled or drafting fails;
  identify it as an evidence list rather than an authored construction scope.
- Scope drafts are never approved or saved automatically. Review and approve the
  text before using it. Source references do not establish authorization or
  prove a complete takeoff.
- When enabled, the configured AI provider receives drawing text and BOM data
  to create the scope draft.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/MaddogSTD/engineering-app/compare/v0.1.25...v0.1.26
